body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: headroom-compressor-e2e-provider
spec:
  displayName: Headroom Compressor E2E Provider
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /headroom-compressor-e2e-provider/latest
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:{{echoLlmMockPort}}
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: hc-main
spec:
  displayName: hc-main
  version: v1.0
  context: /hc-main
  provider:
    id: headroom-compressor-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: headroom-compressor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            jsonPath: "$.messages"
            modelLimit: 800
            targetRatio: 0.4
            protectRecent: 4
            minTokensToCompress: 10
            compressUserMessages: false
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: hc-compress-user
spec:
  displayName: hc-compress-user
  version: v1.0
  context: /hc-compress-user
  provider:
    id: headroom-compressor-e2e-provider
  policies:
    - name: headroom-compressor
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            jsonPath: "$.messages"
            modelLimit: 800
            targetRatio: 0.4
            protectRecent: 4
            minTokensToCompress: 10
            compressUserMessages: true
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]
